name: Cognee
description: AI memory combining knowledge graphs with vector storage.
descriptionZh: 融合知识图谱与向量存储的 AI 记忆平台。
keyFact: Cognee is an Apache-2.0 AI memory platform that combines knowledge graphs with vector storage behind a four-verb API of remember, recall, forget and improve; it is developed by Germany's Topoteretes UG and ships a cognee-mcp integration plus a managed Cognee Cloud.
keyFactZh: Cognee 是 Apache-2.0 的 AI 记忆平台，把知识图谱与向量存储融合在一个由 remember/recall/forget/improve 四个动词构成的 API 之后；它由德国的 Topoteretes UG 开发，提供 cognee-mcp 集成与托管的 Cognee Cloud。
